name: t6-landfill
prompt: Exactly as in the image: at the edge of a municipal landfill under a hazy evening sky, a man in his sixties in a checked shirt, reading glasses pushed up on his head, holds a tablet whose screen stays a plain blank white, beside an officer in a dark uniform and two witnesses, a man and a woman; a yellow excavator works far behind them. He looks up at the officer, nods, and says, in an Indian English accent: "All four signatures. Now it's on the record." The officer nods back. His face and lips move naturally with his words. The camera is locked off. Audio: his voice clear and close, a faint wind and the distant excavator, no music.
negative_prompt: subtitles, captions, watermark, on-screen text, music, singing, children, deformed hands, extra fingers, morphing face, distorted mouth, flicker
shipped: the Veo output re-encoded for the repository (H.264 crf 20, AAC 160k); the original stays in src/clips/talk/
